articles.title: Hobbit Hip Bones Reveal Surprising Human-Like Walk
articles.summary: New analysis of a tiny extinct 'hobbit' (Homo floresiensis) shows its pelvis was human-like, meaning it walked upright like us — but slowly. The mystery of its origins deepens.

articles.title: High Schoolers Run Real Physics Experiment at CERN
articles.summary: Six Indian high schoolers won a global contest to run a real particle physics experiment at CERN. With help from an MIT grad student, they're studying rare pion interactions that could aid the DUNE neutrino experiment.

articles.title: Jackie the Bald Eagle Dies, But Her Legacy Lives On
articles.summary: Jackie, the beloved bald eagle from Big Bear Valley, California, died on August 10, 2026, at about 14. Millions watched her on a live webcam. Her mate Shadow returns to the nest.
